name_zh: 斯塔托/埃克森：北海石油与主权财富基金治理
name_en: Statoil/Equinor: North Sea Oil & Sovereign Wealth Governance
description_zh: 挪威国家石油公司 (Statoil, 1972成立，2018更名 Equinor) 是北海石油开发的主力，其利润直接注入挪威政府养老基金全球 (GPFG)，规模超1.5万亿美元，成为世界最大主权财富基金。核心治理模式：资源租金100%归国家、道德准则委员会排除不符合伦理投资、跨党派政治共识锁定"只花收益不花本金"。这体现了北欧信任资本 (M151) 在资源诅咒缓解 (M168) 中的制度化复利。
description_en: Norway's state oil company (Statoil, founded 1972, renamed Equinor 2018) led North Sea development; profits flow directly into the Government Pension Fund Global (GPFG), now >$1.5T, world's largest SWF. Core governance: 100% resource rent to state, Ethics Council excludes unethical investments, cross-party consensus locks "spend only returns not principal". This exemplifies Nordic Trust Capital (M151) institutionalized for resource curse mitigation (M168) with intergenerational compounding.
reason_zh: 挪威避免了"荷兰病"和资源诅咒，核心在于将地质运气转化为制度红利：透明度+道德约束+代际契约。Equinor 从石油向海上风电/碳捕获/氢能转型，展示 M169 后资源转型治理。
reason_en: Norway avoided Dutch disease & resource curse by turning geological luck into institutional dividends: transparency + ethical constraints + intergenerational contract. Equinor's pivot from oil to offshore wind/CCS/hydrogen demonstrates M169 post-resource transition governance.
steps_zh: 资源国有化确权：1963年大陆架法确立国家对海底资源主权
建立国家石油公司：Statoil 100%国有，技术自主+利润上缴
立法锁定收益流向：1990年养老基金法，只花实质回报率3%
道德准则外部监督：独立委员会可排除烟草/武器/严重环保违规企业
转型锚定长期主义：2020年气候路线图，2050净零，海上风电装机目标12-16GW
steps_en: Resource sovereignty: 1963 Continental Shelf Act established state ownership of seabed resources
Create NOC: Statoil 100% state-owned, technical autonomy + profit upstreaming
Legislate revenue lock-in: 1990 Pension Fund Act, spend only 3% real return
Ethical oversight: independent council can exclude tobacco/weapons/severe ESG violators
Transition anchored in long-termism: 2020 climate roadmap, net-zero 2050, 12-16GW offshore wind target
expected_zh: 资源型小国实现跨代际财富保值增值，避免荷兰病，建立可复制的资源治理黄金标准。
expected_en: Resource-rich small nation achieves intergenerational wealth preservation/growth, avoids Dutch disease, establishes replicable gold standard for resource governance.
case_zh: GPFG 2023年市值15.6万亿挪威克朗，人均约290万克朗；Equinor 2023年可再生能源投资占比超30%，Dogger Bank风电场成全球最大。
case_en: GPFG 2023 value NOK 15.6T, ~NOK 2.9M per capita; Equinor 2023 renewables >30% capex, Dogger Bank world's largest wind farm.
cross_cultural_impact: Global SWF governance model; Santiago Principles co-author; resource curse avoidance case study worldwide
colonial_history: Norway independent 1905; no colonies but Arctic whaling history
resource_curse_mitigation: 100% resource rent to SWF; 3% spending rule; Ethics Council exclusion list; full transparency (EITI founding member)
